title: Prasarita Padottanasana C

sequence.action: Place the hands on waist and stand, as in (A) and (B) above.
Lock the fingers behind the back, swell the chest, and stand.
Slowly place the head on the floor, straightening and tightening both the arms and legs, and do puraka and rechaka as much as possible.
Without unlocking the hands, lift the head up, using the strength of the waist only.
Unlock the hands from behind the back and place them on the waist.

benefits: If this is done, the anal canal will be purified, the bad fat in the lower abdomen will dissolve, the waist will become thin and strong, and the body will become light and beautiful.
This asana also cures constipation, and purifies the top part of the spinal column and the waist.
benefits_source: Given in the book under Prasarita Padottanasana (D), for all four parts.
cautions: Great attention should be paid to the stomach and the anal channel while practicing the four parts of Prasarita Padottanasana.
It is best to learn the proper method from a Guru.
